name: Abu Batata
storyline:
In the crowded streets of Egypt, you begin with nothing more than a worn wooden sweet potato cart and a dream of building a better life.

Every customer matters. Every coin counts.

Your biggest motivation isn't becoming rich—it's helping your sick mother, who desperately needs expensive medical treatment. As bills continue to pile up, you must work day and night selling sweet potatoes, upgrading your equipment, attracting more customers, and making difficult decisions to keep your small business alive.

Along the way you'll meet unforgettable characters, strange customers, local vendors, and unique personalities that make every day different. Some people will help you, others will try to take advantage of you, and a few may completely change your journey.

Abu Batata combines business simulation, progression, humor, and emotional storytelling to recreate the atmosphere of an authentic Egyptian neighborhood.
summary: Abu Batata is a first-person street vendor simulator set in the lively streets of Egypt. Cook and sell sweet potatoes, upgrade your cart, attract different types of customers, negotiate prices, customize your equipment, and experience a story inspired by everyday Egyptian life. Expand your business while balancing customer satisfaction, upgrades, and the challenges of surviving as a small street vendor.
